title: Backup & Restore
cloudQuotaUnavailable: Sign in to use Soulbits Cloud storage
folderPickerUnavailable: Folder picker is unavailable on this device
estimateMessage: About {{size}} will be uploaded to {{target}}. It counts against your storage.
recoveryHelp: Keep this code somewhere safe. It is the one way to restore your backup if you lose access to your account or your other devices.
regenerateWarning: This creates a new key for future backups. Older backups stay restorable only with the previous recovery code. Anyone you gave the old code will no longer be able to restore new backups.
passphraseHelp: Add a passphrase so only someone who knows it can restore this backup. Your recovery code and account sign-in still work.
honestW1: Your backup is encrypted end-to-end and stored in your own cloud. Soulbits stores only a locked copy of your backup key and cannot read your backup without attacking your account.
honestAlways: If you lose all unlock methods, neither Soulbits nor your cloud provider can recover your data.
footer: Your data is never stored on Soulbits's servers — only in the storage you choose.
restoreIntro: Sign in and pick where your backup lives. Enter your recovery code (or passphrase) to unlock it.
restoreRecoveryHelp: Your recovery code is the 64-character code shown when you set up backup.
restoreDoneHelp: Your backup was verified and staged. It will be applied the next time the app starts.
restoreFooter: Restoring replaces nothing until you restart — you can back out safely.
offerIntro: We found a backup for your account. You can restore it to this device now, or start fresh and set up backup later.
offerFooter: Restoring replaces this device's data with the backup. Starting fresh leaves everything as it is now — you can restore any time from Backup & Restore.
